definitions.explanation: Receiving part of one's wages or allowance before the day it is due. Figuratively, using up now something meant for later, such as tomorrow's energy or next year's budget.

examples.japanese: ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{前借|まえが}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To get an advance on one's pay.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お⟦{小遣|こづか}い→小遣い：12363_kozukai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{前借|まえが}り⟦させて→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Let me have next month's allowance in advance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{払|はら}えなく→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たの}んで→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前借|まえが}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't pay the rent, so I asked the company for an advance on my salary.

notes:
Made of ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧ (before) + ⟦{借|か}り→借りる：00532_kariru⟧ (borrowing), from ⟦{借|か}りる→借りる：00532_kariru⟧. The money is one's own, only taken early, so it is not a loan from a bank.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{前借|まえが}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to get an advance on one's salary
- お⟦{小遣|こづか}い→小遣い：12363_kozukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前借|まえが}り: an advance on one's allowance
- ⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前借|まえが}り: drawing on tomorrow's energy (figurative)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{前払|まえばら}い→前払い：15782_maebarai⟧: paying in advance (the payer's side)
- ⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧: debt, borrowed money
